title: Care Center Training Note — Registration and Replacement Terms Across Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards
content:
Which kinds of Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards can be registered to a customer's profile, which carry lost-card protection, and on what replacement terms? The answers are fixed per card kind.

| Card kind | Can be registered to a profile | Lost or stolen balance can move to a replacement | Replacement fee | Business days to issue a replacement | Balance protected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Yes | Yes | $0.00 | 7 | Balance at the time of the report |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | Yes | Yes | $0.00 | 1 | Balance at the time of the report |
| Merchandise Credit Card | Yes | Yes | $0.00 | 7 | Balance at the time of the report |
| Registry Reward Card | Yes | Yes | $0.00 | 1 | Balance at the time of the report |
| Corporate Gift Card | No | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Balance at the time of the report |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | No | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Balance at the time of the report |

## Questions answered by the table

**Which kinds can be registered?** The Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, the Marlowe & Finch eGift Card, the Merchandise Credit Card and the Registry Reward Card. The Corporate Gift Card and the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card cannot be registered to a profile.

**Which kinds carry lost-card protection?** The same four kinds: for each of them a registered card's balance, if the card is lost or stolen, can be moved to a replacement card. The Corporate Gift Card and the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card carry no lost-card protection.

**What does a replacement cost?** $0.00 on every kind that can be replaced.

**How long does a replacement take to be issued?** 7 business days for a plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card or Merchandise Credit Card; 1 business day for a digital Marlowe & Finch eGift Card or Registry Reward Card.

**Which balance is protected?** On every kind the protected balance is the balance at the time of the report: value already spent before the report forms no part of it.

### Hypothetical example

A hypothetical registered Merchandise Credit Card held $240.00, of which $40.00 was spent before the holder reported the card lost. The balance at the time of the report is $240.00 less $40.00, which is $200.00, and a replacement of this kind is issued within 7 business days for a fee of $0.00.
